I couldn't schedule the Monday digest, so nothing will post on its own next Monday (Oct 19). The scheduler rejected my request with an authentication error. I didn't try to get around it.

I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. The reply says the Gateway admin needs to fix the scheduler credentials first. Once that's done, I can create the job: every Monday at 08:00 Central, posting "Coastal week ahead" in #coastal-team. It would draw on last week's messages in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items.

Until then, she can ping me on Monday morning and I'll post the digest by hand.
